Jae (AE): Safeguard Systems agreed to a 10-day POC. Scope: streaming client -> tool/function calls for realtime moderation -> structured JSON envelope for reranker. They sit behind an enterprise proxy that drops SSE after ~65s. Demo requested Mon 9am PT. Need SE + runtime + security + finance input.
Rina (SE): I can own the runbook. Quick: do they insist on Dedicated for KMS/SAML or will hosted with our SOC2 attestation be OK for the demo? Also what's their acceptable tail latency?
Paul (Runtime): Tech constraints: they have docs up to ~18k tokens; target tail latency ~300ms interactive. Proxy closes SSE ~65s. Recommend websocket fallback, heartbeat every 12s, and chunked upload for large docs. Use ephemeral creds for demo.
Sam (Security): From their questionnaire: they prefer customer-managed KMS + SAML for production. Hosted demo OK if they accept SOC2 attestation. Ask them for SAML metadata and an example KMS key policy. Confirm whether they want audit logs forwarded to their SIEM (we support syslog/HTTP collector on Dedicated/Private).
Eve (Finance): Ballpark for a 10-day trial with reserved capacity (1x A10G-equivalent peak, ~3-5 vGPU-days): offer $5k trial credit + hands-on support. Function/tool calls = $0.002/call + per-token inference fees. We'll include an example cost table in the deck.
Rina (SE): Paul, can you paste a minimal handshake (prefer SSE, fallback websocket), a tiny node ws fallback, and a sample structured-output schema we can hand to their infra/security? Need a curl snippet and a short JSON schema.
Paul (Runtime): Sure — keep TTL short for ephemeral tokens. Handshake (prefer SSE, fallback):

curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_TOKEN>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-4b","max_tokens":20000,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket","chunked_upload":true}'

Paul (Runtime): Websocket fallback (node):

const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <EPHEMERAL_TOKEN>' } });
ws.on('open', () => { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd-stream-4b', max_tokens: 20000 })); });
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('evt', m));
setInterval(() => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'heartbeat' })), 12000);

Paul (Runtime): Example streaming event when assistant invokes moderation tool:

event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"moderation","args":{"text":"<excerpt>"},"trace_id":"sg-001"}

Paul (Runtime): Structured output (assistant final content) — JSON Schema embedded as string in the response content:

{"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"category\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"confidence\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"action":"allow","category":"finance","confidence":0.03}}}]}

Rina (SE): For client reliability: recommend window=6 concurrent in-flight chunks, heartbeat=12s, exponential backoff with full jitter on reconnect. For large docs use chunked_upload to let the runtime prefix-cache repeated segments. Server recs: prefix KV cache enabled, auto-batch target=24 to keep p50 cost down.
Eve (Finance): Example math: if they do 4k moderation calls/day at avg 180 tokens/call => tool fees = 4k * $0.002 = $8/day plus token costs. We'll show daily and monthly projections.
Sam (Security): Action items: request SAML metadata XML, KMS policy snippet, and whether they want audit-log delivery to SIEM. Note: ephemeral tokens for demos must be <=2h and logged.
forge-bot: ephemeral token created (valid 02:00:00) token-id: tok-safeguard-2122-demo (demo only)
Jae (AE): Demo Mon 9am PT. Rina, Paul, Sam attending. Safeguard asked to push a 10k token doc and trigger moderation + structured output. Confirm readiness by Fri EOD.
Rina (SE): Confirmed. I'll assemble a 1-page runbook (ephemeral creds flow, handshake + ws fallback, chunked upload example, structured schema, proxy tips, escalation contacts) and send to their infra.
Paul (Runtime): I'll prepare a small docker image with websocket fallback + chunked-uploader + a short load script (image: docker.pkg.redwood/safeguard-demo:latest) and post link by Fri.
Sam (Security): I'll email Safeguard security lead for SAML metadata and KMS policy, and confirm SOC2 attestation delivery method.
Jae (AE): Thanks team — high priority. If proxy or token-rate blockers appear during smoke, escalate to eng-sre and ping me.
